notes.title: Keeping a low profile
notes.content:
Hello partisans!

In order to succeed in WORLD WAR II: UNDERGROUND you will need to be stealth almost all the time. Every action has its own, harsh consequences and you don't want to see them for yourself. You need to be very careful, especially when there's a lot of enemies nearby!

notes.title: Safety vaults
notes.content:
Hello partisans!

In WORLD WAR II: UNDERGROUND you will have several occasions to steal the documents and make use of it. In order to do this you will need to find different safety vaults located on the map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41413691/22730227229766660ebf22ad02be747207a3847e.png

The documents found inside will be the crucial elements in achieving your goals, but for now let's leave it as a secret...

Are you curious about what's coming next? 
Don't forget to leave your comments!

notes.title: Your decisions
notes.content:
Hello partisans!

There are many missions ahead of you! 
Not all of them will be about fighting and blowing something up.
You will also have to adapt to the situation and choose the right answers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41413691/ce783b2a176b067f3de432cb522765643945a668.jpg

Your decisions will determine how your game develops, each mission will allow you to finish it in multiple different ways.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41413691/d5a195d8fa7c73aaa40cb9be85e870df4e5f14ff.jpg

Are you curious about the ending options? Leave your question in the comments!
See you next time!

notes.title: Harsh conditions
notes.content:
Hello partisans!

Soldiers and partisans must be prepared for different weather conditions.
Winter has always been the hardest period during the Second World War, therefore, when planning various types of missions, the Allies had to be equipped not only with efficient weapons but also with warm clothing and provisions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41413691/a9324d71791eca739ba74090ff1345309c00e416.jpg

Sneaking in winter conditions is more difficult because thicker clothing restricts your movements and snow crushed under the soles of shoes can betray your presence! 

Frosty weather can be a hindrance, but use it as your advantage against your opponent. Frost and snow affect everyone, even German soldiers.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41413691/ab1da17c4f2cdbdd4ee5f1e52b9eef6901316bd9.jpg

notes.title: INTRODUCTION
notes.content:
Hello partisans!

Have you seen our game trailer? What do You think about World War II: Underground so far?

As You may not know it’s a stealth game placed in occupied Europe. You will have a chance to play the role of a partisan who is working with other underground soldiers to defeat Nazis. 🧨

We are curious if we have here history lovers or players interested in World War II? 😄
Feel free to leave a comment, we are open to suggestions and very curious about what are your assumptions and expectations about the game are. 😁

Check out our discord community too! We encourage you to chat with us and other players. 😊
